bio: This restaurant serves a wide range of Asian cuisine – sushi, curries and wok dishes are the highlights, and the focus is squarely on the quality of the ingredients. Inside, there is a minimalist decor and open kitchen; outside, a lovely covered terrace. The trip to Grünwald is definitely worthwhile. Marily, which sells ice cream and confectionery in summer, is housed in the same building. Tip: Park free of charge in the multi-storey car park on Marktplatz a few metres away....
